q1.question: How is it different from existing tools?
q1.answer: TubeGAI isn't just another editing tool. It integrates your entire video production pipeline—from idea discovery to final editing—into a single AI-powered workflow. Trend analysis, script writing, storyboard generation, editing, and SEO optimization all connect seamlessly in one platform.

q2.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
q2.answer: Not at all! TubeGAI is designed for creators of all experience levels. Our intuitive interface and AI assistant guide you through each step, so even beginners can create professional-quality content.

q3.question: Is there a free trial?
q3.answer: Yes! You can start for free without a credit card. The free plan includes 3 projects per month, 10 AI script generations, and basic trend analysis features.

q4.question: Can I use it on mobile?
q4.answer: Currently, TubeGAI is optimized for desktop and tablet. A mobile app is planned for release in the first half of 2024, featuring dedicated iOS and Android apps for managing projects on the go.
